summary.text: Heavenly Web Protection Veil is a heaven path killer move named when Paradise Earth blocks Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

claims.text: Giant Sun Immortal Venerable charges toward Fang Yuan. Countless golden light rays shoot at Fang Yuan like spears or swords. Fang Yuan tells Paradise Earth to defend while he attacks. Paradise Earth hesitates for a bit before nodding. Heavenly web protection veil is named. A milky white light web appears once again, pure without any dust. There are large gaps but they do not allow anything in. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s golden light rays are completely blocked by the heavenly web.

Fang Yuan retreats toward Paradise Earth. Paradise Earth takes a deep breath and activates heavenly web protection veil once again. Fang Yuan obtains a brief respite. When the two venerables break the heavenly web, Zhan Bu Du and Qi Sea Ancestor arrive to reinforce him.

Fang Yuan refines a heaven path Immortal Gu that looks like a crystal spider, clear and transparent with no flaws on the body. The spider’s eight legs are slim and long, and its small body is raised high by the eight legs. The rank eight heaven path Immortal Gu heavenly web is named. This Gu is the core of heavenly web protection veil. In Crazed Demon Cave, Paradise Earth used it multiple times. It has outstanding defensive properties, on par with Fang Yuan’s reverse flow protection seal. After Fang Yuan killed Paradise Earth, he found heavenly web Gu and heavenly birth Gu in the immortal aperture. Paradise Earth formed many heaven path killer moves like heavenly web protection veil, emotionless heaven and earth, heavenly summary earthly norm, and others. These Immortal Gu were all destroyed by Paradise Earth’s will before his death.
